notes.title: Update 0.2.2
notes.content:
[p]New patch brings expansion of core T1 building meaning players can now choose upgrading path for T1 building. 6 new units were added with unique abilities. 

Better logic for AI opponents. Firstly, a much needed fix for ultimate strike usage by AI players. Also added Easy, Hard and Expert difficulties with expanded strategies that will be expanded even more in upcoming updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Music for all factions. In order to make the faction feel more immersive we have added unique background music for each faction.[/p][h3]
added[/h3][list][*][p]+ 6 new T1.2 unit with unique abilities, 1 per faction. Players can now choose upgrading path for T1 building[/p][/*][*][p]+ added AI players difficulty variants. Also expanded AI strategy.[/p][/*][*][p]+ background music to each faction, around 60 audio files in total[/p][/*][*][p]+ more sound effects for building structures[/p][/*][*][p]+ tooltips for resources panel and team stats panel[/p][/*][*][p]+ match timer into UI [/p][/*][*][p]+ visual variants for HoT abilities, visual duration now matches actual heal duration[/p][/*][*][p]+ creative panel setup is now saving into user preferences[/p][/*][*][p]+ pulsating visual effect on structure upgrade button[/p][/*][*][p]+ manabar under health bar of units and buildings[/p][/*][/list][h3]changed[/h3][list][*][p]~ reduced human T1.1 production income from 2 to 3 gold, farm stats is now in line with other buildings[/p][/*][*][p]~ reduced hitbox size of all units, units now fight closer to each other[/p][/*][*][p]~ reduced max projectile lifetime from 3s to 2.5s [/p][/*][*][p]~ tuned T1 elf death sound effect[/p][/*][*][p]~ game is paused when campaign level is finished[/p][/*][*][p]~ creative panel maximize button [/p][/*][*][p]~ undead builder now builds Bone tower instead of Arrow tower[/p][/*][*][p]~ improved structure detail income label UX, instead of showing income gain it now shows previous income and new income (old: 5 ,new: 10 -> 15)[/p][/*][*][p]~ all structures now reward the player with income. Previously, only unit production buildings did.[/p][/*][*][p]~ change anti-aliasing to TSR[/p][/*][*][p]~ changed building placement and sync materials to be compatible with nanite[/p][/*][/list][h3]fixed[/h3][list][*][p]~ ultimate strike conditions for AI players, preventing double tapping units when not needed[/p][/*][*][p]~ team ultimate strike amount now show correct amount after round reset[/p][/*][*][p]~ list of resolution presets for windowed mode[/p][/*][*][p]~ moving audio slider now apply volume change in real time as you drag[/p][/*][*][p]~ sound effects hearing distance, all far away sounds should now be silent[/p][/*][*][p]~ orc chieftain team color selection[/p][/*][*][p]~ some walk animations visual adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content: [p]This update focuses on some quality of life changes and fixing minor bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]+ added player builder auto-building nearby unfinished structures [/p][p]+ added option to pause the game in singleplayer map[/p][p]+ added option to hide quest panel in singleplayer map[/p][p]+ added heroes resurrection instead of failing mission in singleplayer campaign maps[/p][p]~ changed all common projectiles lifetime, max 3s[/p][p]~ changed structures under construction do not interact with enemy projectiles[/p][p]~ changed faction specific utility structures cost lower[/p][p]~ changed chat and console is now shown in campaign[/p][p]~ fixed production buildings can now be synced even while being constructed[/p][p]~ fixed custom resolution setting input field in graphical settings[/p]

notes.title: Dwarves Update
notes.content:
[p]I am pleased to announce the first major update for Fortress Frenzy. Update 0.2.0 brings a new playable faction, the DWARVES! Get ready your axes and awaken sleeping ice giants.

Patch Notes: update 0.2.0[/p][p]+ added [b]dwarves faction[/b][/p][p]+ added [b]14 new units, 16 new abilities, 16 new buildings[/b] [/p][p]+ added [b]1 arena map[/b] (Dwarven Mountains)[/p][p]+ added [b]1 new achievement[/b] (win with dwarves)[/p][p]+ new cinematic trailer for dwarves[/p][p]+ new gameplay trailer[/p][p]~ changed default anti-aliasing to FFA[/p][p]~ [b]improved shadows quality[/b] by increasing bounding boxes for weapons and other 3D models attached to characters[/p][p]~ fixed multiplayer mini-map not being targeted at local player[/p][p]~ reduced [b]corpse decomposition time from 20s to 6s[/b][/p][p]~ fixed missing animation bled-time for protector (human T3.1)[/p][p]~ fixed wrong team assignment for lobby slot after kicking player[/p][p]~ small build-able zone adjustments[/p]

notes.title: Devlog: Dwarves Update work in progress...
notes.content: [p]It has been a month since release. Next update will bring new builder, visual upgrades, bug fixes and also an experimental cinematic trailer. I have scheduled the release of this update for July 11th. [/p]
